caption: The drawing features a wooden corner cabinet set against a plain beige background. The cabinet is brown with a wood grain texture and is designed to fit into a corner, as indicated by its triangular base and back. The top section of the cabinet has a semi-circular arch with a small, elevated semicircular shelf. Below this, there is an open shelf with a circular cutout in its surface, and to the left, a small rectangular drawer with a round knob pulls out. The main section below the open shelf is empty, forming a triangular open space. At the bottom, the cabinet has a curved front with three rectangular drawers, each fitted with a round brass knob. The unit stands on three tall, straight legs, which are connected by an X-shaped stretcher at the base for support. All the visible surfaces of the cabinet are uniformly brown with visible wood grain effects, and the hardware is gold in color.
title: Washstand
